rule:
Pre-registered selection v3, written 2026-11-12 15:40 before run4 was recorded and before any program was scored on
any v3 set. Supersedes select_sets2.py (whose 30-run set was scored once, by the baselines and the reference reported
in the first PR draft; that set is retired, and its runs are not preferred or avoided here: the draw below is by
recording order only).

Hidden tasks: CuttingToolSelection, MakeIceLemonade, SeparateFreezerRack, PortionHotDogs, RecycleBottlesByType,
PickPlaceCounterToCabinet, PickPlaceCounterToStove (fresh recordings run2, run3, run4). Practice never contains them.

Failed runs (keys3_fresh.json, key_v3.py):
  1. cls in drop / miss / misplace, replay with 0 term mismatches and 0 state error, not excluded by key v3;
  2. per class: up to 16 runs, drawn round-robin over the hidden tasks (alphabetical), each task's runs in recording
     order (run, then case id), at most 8 from one task.
Successful runs (succ_fresh.json, succ_candidates.py; the recorded simulator success flag):
  3. every recorded success is eligible, including ones with recovered drops or missed grasps, if its recording has at
     least 200 frames (10 s; amended 2026-11-12 17:25 when the first assembly failed on a 2-frame RecycleBottlesByType
     'success': scenes the simulator counted complete at or near the start; 10 s leaves at least 5 s of playback after
     the 3-5 s tail). No score had been computed on any v3 set;
  4. up to 40, round-robin over the hidden tasks, recording order within a task, at most 8 from one task.
Audit exclusions: runs listed in audit_exclude.json are dropped before the draw (the next in order replaces them).
Practice: every practice-task failed run passing 1 and every practice-task success in succ_practice.json.

    select_sets3.py <practice_fail_keys3> <practice_succ> <hidden_fail_keys3> <hidden_succ>

AMENDMENT A3:
Selection v4 = amendment A3 (2026-11-12, after the independent review of key v3; before any hidden scoring).
Changes to select_sets3.py (whose quotas, round-robin draw and recording order stay):
  * two failure types only: drop and miss (released_off_target dropped from the task);
  * hidden failed runs: excluded if any recovered drop or missed grasp (decoys.py, any type, any object) occurs before
    the onset; hidden successful runs: excluded if the recording contains any recovered drop or missed grasp;
  * key v3 now also excludes drops and misses on objects no place term names ('object_not_in_instruction');
  * audit_exclude.json lists the reviewer's and the coordinator's run exclusions.
Practice: every practice-task failed run of the two types passing key v3 (recovered events allowed, stated in the
instruction) and every practice success of >= 10 s.

    select_sets4.py <practice_fail_keys3> <practice_succ> <hidden_fail_keys3> <hidden_succ>

AMENDMENT A4 (and A5, in key_v4.py check d):
Selection v5 = amendment A4 (2026-11-12, after the independent review of the A3 replacements; driven only by that
review, made after the one hidden scoring of the A3 set, and not based on any score). Same as select_sets4.py (A3),
with key v4 (key_v4.py: relevance by object, no concerned object left unmet or goal undone before the onset, subject
margin >= 3 cm) applied to every run, practice and hidden. The whole hidden pool is re-run through the coded checks;
the reviewer's four exclusions (331abcee, 44a8d070, ca024648, 35ac1b14) are caught by the code, not by name.

    select_sets5.py <practice_fail_keys4> <practice_succ> <hidden_fail_keys4> <hidden_succ>

AMENDMENT A7:
Selection v7 = amendment A7 (2026-11-13, coordinator decisions; registered before any A7 run was scored).

Classes: drop, miss (unchanged definitions) and grasped_wrong_object ('wrong', key_v4.wrong_event / derive4).
Keys: key_v4 with the A7 support fix and the wrong-object class (key_v4.py), A3-A5 eligibility unchanged
(term replay clean, recovered drop/miss before the onset excluded, audit_exclude.json), A7 scene rule (a7_rule.py,
X = 15 cm) as the 'multi' flag.

Hidden tasks: the A6 hidden tasks (run2-run4 and A7 PortionHotDogs recordings) and the three hidden near variants
(PickPlaceCounterToCabinetNear, PickPlaceCounterToStoveNear, PickPlaceSinkToCounterNear; pilot + campaign).
PickPlaceDrawerToCounterNear is practice only.

Hidden failed runs (round-robin over tasks, alphabetical, each task's runs in recording order; cap 8 per task; within a
task a pick is skipped, and stays available, if it would put one subject category above floor(0.6 * picks) (at least
1), so no category exceeds 60% of a task's picks):
  * wrong: 16, from every eligible wrong row (multi-object by construction: the scene holds the instruction's subject
    and the grasped distractor);
  * drop: 16 = every eligible multi drop first (round-robin as above), then the A6 hidden drops (single-object ones
    included) in their A6 order until 16, keeping the cap of 8 per task;
  * miss: the 15 A6 hidden misses, unchanged (their single-object concentration is disclosed), plus at most one
    eligible multi miss from the A7 recordings (first in recording order) to reach 16.
Successful runs: 40, round-robin over the tasks of the selected failures (cap 8), >= 200 frames, no recovered drop or
missed grasp and no distractor lifted (key_v4.wrong_event) anywhere in the run, audit exclusions applied.

    select_sets7.py <hidden_fail_keys.json> <hidden_succ.json> <a6_sel_hidden.json> <out.json>

amendments.what: A7 (registered before any A7 run was keyed for selection or scored; coordinator decisions after the A6 frontier audit and the A7 pilot). (1) New failure type grasped_wrong_object: the gripper closes on (both finger pads) and lifts >= 3 cm one of the scene's distractor objects (objects RoboCasa adds that the instruction does not name and the success check does not read; never a receptacle, a place target, a goal object or its interchangeable copy); onset = first frame of the >= 3 cm lift; the object to name is the grasped one; exclusions: no unmet place term at the end, onset in the last 5 s, any drop or miss (recovered or not) before the onset, the A4 left-unmet / undone checks, the 3 cm subject margin at the lift frame; a drop or miss run in which a distractor is also lifted is excluded (one keyed event per failed run). (2) Support fix in key_v4 check (c) and the scene rule: a support must be under the subject (touching, subject centre within its scaled bounding-box footprint and above its box centre); re-run on the whole pool before A7 keying: no hidden eligibility changed, one practice miss became eligible (PickPlaceCounterToStove c02910). (3) Scene rule a7_multi: another graspable candidate (RoboCasa graspable, not a RoboCasa receptacle, or moved by a place term; not the subject's category, targets or supports) within 15 cm of the subject at the reference frame (miss: closing; drop: grasp start; wrong: lift). (4) New recordings: near variants (work/a7_variants.py: the RoboCasa task plus one object from the target's pool within 12 cm of it; instruction, success check, horizon and XR-1 unchanged): CounterToCabinetNear, CounterToStoveNear, SinkToCounterNear (hidden), DrawerToCounterNear (practice only), and PortionHotDogs (hidden), seeds drawn by os.urandom and written before each run (fresh/a7_seeds.json). (5) Hidden composition (select_sets7.py): 16 grasped_wrong_object (cap 8 per task, no grasped category above 60% of a task's picks), 16 drops (multi-object first, then the A6 drops in A6 order), the 15 A6 misses unchanged plus at most one multi-object miss, 40 successes round-robin over the failure tasks (no recovered event, no distractor lifted). Misses stay concentrated in single-object PickPlace scenes; disclosed.
amendments.post_review: 2026-11-16, after the independent review of the A7 key (design/review-mfd-key-a7.md: 20 new hidden contact sheets, 17 ok and 3 out; round 2: both refills ok), before any A7 scoring. (a) Same-category fix in key_v4.wrong_event: a distractor whose category equals a subject's or a target's category is not a wrong object (the instruction already excluded "a copy of an object the task needs"); whole pool re-keyed: 3 hidden wrong-object rows (two of them flagged by the review, PickPlaceCounterToStoveNear c00033 and PickPlaceSinkToCounterNear c00235) and 6 practice rows leave the class. key_v4.py sha256 at registration b9419941..., after the fix 30da7c71.... (b) PickPlaceCounterToStoveNear c00069 (drop) excluded by name (audit_exclude.json): it reads as a missed grasp (the 1 s hold counts frames with the fingers open); the drop rule is unchanged, since every earlier drop was reviewed under it. (c) Refills by the registered draw: MakeIceLemonade c00145 (drop), PickPlaceCounterToStoveNear c00417 (wrong, corn), PickPlaceSinkToCounterNear c00251 (wrong, orange). Instruction wording: "never an object of the same category as one the task needs"; the near-variant note says "drawn from the same pool of objects". (d) a7_build.py (the keying driver) was edited after registration (2026-11-14 00:03, before the first A7 keying and before any scoring); sha256 at registration e10d69c3..., now 1c6fd954.... Final hidden set: 16 grasped_wrong_object, 16 dropped_after_grasp, 16 grasp_missed, 40 successful.

amendments.what: Offline form (whole-video tickets with a location field) replaced by the online form (chunked playback, one alarm, timeliness, false-alarm factor) by owner decision. The location filter of v1 was dropped with the location field; successful runs were added as negatives (rules 3-4). No hidden run had been recorded or keyed when this was decided.
Two hidden tasks (PortionHotDogs, RecycleBottlesByType; run3) added before any fresh run was keyed, because public yields showed the missed-grasp class came from one task only.
Rule 3 extended (no recovered drop or missed grasp in a successful run) before any fresh run was selected, so that the instruction can state it exactly.

A6 (no re-selection: the same 71 hidden runs and the same key). Made after a frontier run: Claude Opus 5.5 scored 0.67 and 0.45 on commit 60ee275, and an audit showed a video-blind rule on the gripper aperture scored 0.629 on the hidden set. The agent-visible surface changed: the finger aperture and the wrist force and torque are no longer streamed or in the practice logs; the gripper command is reduced to the policy's binary decision. The key still uses the simulator record internally.

A5 (final) after an independent review of the A4 refills, made after scoring and driven only by that review, not by scores: a drop is excluded when the gripper is commanded open within 0.5 s after the onset (a set-down that missed). Window from the reviewed cases (0.3, 0.4, 1.1 s) and the kept drops (opening from 0.75 s). Whole pool re-run: one hidden drop replaced by the next in recording order (MakeIceLemonade), one practice drop removed.

A4 after an independent review of the A3 replacements, made after the one hidden scoring of the A3 set and driven only by that review, not by scores: key v4 (key_v4.py) codes relevance by object (own goal or a declared interchangeable copy), no goal undone and no concerned object left unmet before the onset, and a subject margin of at least 3 cm against other candidates. The candidate set of the margin rule was revised twice after seeing eligible counts (never scores). The whole pool was re-run; refilled in recording order under the registered cap of 8 per task. Misses reach 15 of 16 (17 eligible, cap binds at PickPlaceCounterToCabinet); accepted by the coordinator.

A3 after an independent review of the v3 key (13 exclusions, 10 of them releases): released_off_target removed (off-target judged against simulator placement thresholds was not fair from video, and success tails could not be matched to release events); hidden failed runs with any recovered drop or miss before the onset and hidden successes with any recovered drop or miss excluded; drops and misses keyed only on objects a place term names; explicit exclusions in audit_exclude.json; refill from the pool in recording order. No hidden score had been computed on v3.

Review round (red team and maintainer review of the 30-run v2 set, which had been scored by the baselines and the reference): key v3 (causal miss object, release onset at the opening, exclusions for resting on another object and for an earlier sustained undo), random 3-5 s tails, 0.5 s early tolerance, successes with recovered events kept, larger stratified quotas (select_sets3.py), and run4 on two former practice tasks for the missed-grasp class. The v2 set is retired; v3 draws by recording order only.

v2: rule 2 quota per class (N_c = min(8, eligible runs of the class)) instead of one N for all classes, decided after two of five recording chunks from yields alone, before any selection was used or any score computed; N_neg fixed at 8; a class with fewer than 3 runs stops the build.
Audit-exclusion clause registered before any baseline ran on the hidden set: a run whose contact sheet contradicts its key is dropped and replaced by the next in order.
